title: Use OCR to Turn PDF and Image Files into Electronic Documents
summary: Use optical character recognition (OCR) to convert PDF and image files from vendors into electronic documents and purchase invoices in Business Central. Send files to an OCR service directly or by email, correct recognized data, and train the service to improve future accuracy.
features: Send files to OCR service from Incoming Documents page
Forward files by email to OCR provider
Receive electronic documents from OCR service
Create purchase invoices from OCR documents
Send feedback to improve OCR accuracy
Job queue integration for scheduled processing
